features.name: Flower Catalog Browsing
features.description: Customers can browse, search, and filter flowers and bouquets with photos and prices.
user_stories: As a customer, I can browse flowers by category so that I can find bouquets that suit my occasion.
As a customer, I can search and filter by price and color so that I can quickly find what I want.
acceptance_criteria: Given the catalog page, When I select a category, Then only flowers in that category are displayed with price and photo.
Given the search box, When I enter a keyword, Then matching in-stock items are listed within 2 seconds.

features.name: Cart and Order Placement
features.description: Customers can add flowers to a cart, choose a delivery date and address, and pay online.
user_stories: As a customer, I can add items to a cart so that I can order several bouquets at once.
As a customer, I can pay securely and choose a delivery date so that my flowers arrive when I need them.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in my cart, When I submit a valid address, date, and payment, Then an order is created and a confirmation is shown.
Given a failed payment, When the payment is declined, Then no order is created and I see a clear error message.

features.name: Delivery Tracking
features.description: Customers can follow the status of their order from preparation to doorstep delivery.
user_stories: As a customer, I can track my order status so that I know when my flowers will arrive.
As a courier, I can update delivery status so that customers see accurate progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given a placed order, When its status changes, Then the customer sees the new status and receives a notification.
Given an assigned delivery, When the courier marks it delivered, Then the order is closed with a delivery timestamp.

features.name: User Accounts and Order History
features.description: Customers can register, log in, manage saved addresses, and view past orders.
user_stories: As a customer, I can create an account so that I can save my addresses and details for faster checkout.
As a customer, I can view past orders so that I can easily reorder my favorite bouquets.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new visitor, When I register with a valid email and password, Then my account is created and I am logged in.
Given a logged-in customer, When I open order history, Then all my previous orders are listed with status and totals.

features.name: Admin Catalog and Order Management
features.description: Administrators manage flower inventory, pricing, and incoming orders and assign couriers.
user_stories: As an admin, I can add and edit flowers and stock levels so that the catalog stays accurate.
As an admin, I can view and assign orders to couriers so that deliveries are fulfilled on time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin panel, When I update a flower's price or stock, Then the change appears in the catalog immediately.
Given a new paid order, When I assign a courier, Then the courier sees the order in their delivery list.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Catalog and checkout pages load in under 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users.
All traffic uses HTTPS; passwords are hashed with bcrypt; card data is handled only by a PCI DSS compliant provider.
The system achieves 99.5% monthly uptime, especially around peak holidays such as Valentine's Day and Mother's Day.
A first-time customer can complete an order in under 3 minutes with no more than 5 checkout steps.
Customer addresses and contact data are encrypted at rest and deleted within 30 days of an account deletion request.
